2609.08442.title: AirAnchor: Bridging Local and Global Spatial Information for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
2609.08442.paper_summary: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation requires drones to follow natural-language instructions and navigate through complex urban environments. Accurate navigation relies on both local and global spatial information, which support immediate action grounding and long-horizon path planning, respectively. However, existing zero-shot methods typically operate at a single spatial scale, relying either on local representations constructed online from current observations or on global memories built offline from historical experience. To address this limitation, we propose AirAnchor, a new paradigm that bridges local and global spatial information through spatial anchors and integrates both into a shared navigation framework, enabling comprehensive spatial grounding for decision-making. AirAnchor consists of three core components: (1) Query-Driven Spatial Anchor Grounding, which identifies decision-relevant anchors from visual observations and organizes them into local spatial representations; (2) Persistent Object Spatial Memory, which incrementally maintains an object knowledge base as persistent global spatial memory and retrieves landmark-related spatial priors; and (3) a Spatially-Informed Navigation Agent, which explicitly integrates both local and global spatial information into an agentic framework for decision-making. Extensive experiments on AerialVLN demonstrate that AirAnchor substantially outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed paradigm.
2609.08442.paper_summary_zh: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation 需要無人機遵循自然語言指令並在複雜的城市環境中導航。準確的導航依賴於本地和全球的空間資訊，分別支持即時行動基礎和長期路徑規劃。然而，現有的零樣本方法通常在單一空間尺度上運作，依賴於從當前觀察中在線構建的本地表示或從歷史經驗中離線構建的全球記憶。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 AirAnchor，一種通過空間錨點橋接本地和全球空間資訊的新範式，並將兩者整合到共享的導航框架中，使決策過程中的空間基礎更加全面。AirAnchor 由三個核心組件組成：(1) 查詢驅動的空間錨點基礎，從視覺觀察中識別與決策相關的錨點並將其組織成本地空間表示；(2) 持久物體空間記憶，作為持久的全球空間記憶逐步維護物體知識庫並檢索與地標相關的空間先驗；以及 (3) 空間知識導航代理，明確將本地和全球空間資訊整合到一個代理框架中以進行決策。對 AerialVLN 的廣泛實驗表明，AirAnchor 顯著超越現有的零樣本基準，驗證了所提出範式的有效性和效率。
